XMLDB.COMMENT: Airpay proctoring quiz access rule — per-quiz settings table

TABLE.NAME: quizaccess_sentientia_proctor
TABLE.COMMENT: Per-quiz proctoring settings. Replaces the get_config/set_config keyed-by-quizid pattern that polluted mdl_config_plugins at 1000+ quizzes scale (Phase 8 audit finding N7).

FIELD.NAME: quizid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to mdl_quiz.id — one row per proctored quiz

FIELD.NAME: min_match_score
FIELD.COMMENT: Identity-match threshold override for this quiz (NULL = use site default)

FIELD.NAME: retention_days_override
FIELD.COMMENT: Recording retention override for this quiz (NULL = use site default)
